;#; NOTE: Each line of this file is in the following format:
;#;       messagePattern <tab> dialogResult
;#;       The message pattern is a regular expression to match
;#;       against the message for an interactive dialog (e.g.
;#;       MessageBox, etc).  Dialog messages will be matched
;#;       against each (case-sensitive) regular expression, in
;#;       line-order (i.e. the order shown below).  The dialog
;#;       result must be convertable to the Eagle Boolean type
;#;       -OR- the WinForms DialogResult type.  The first match
;#;       (with a correct dialog result) will cause matching to
;#;       stop and that (associated) dialog result will act as
;#;       the return value.  All literal whitespace values in
;#;       the regular expressions must be escaped.  Whitespace
;#;       is forbidden in the dialog results.  In the future,
;#;       additional fields beyond the first two for each line
;#;       may be added, e.g. matching against dialog title as
;#;       well?
